name: Dr Christina Stefanou
title: Director – Clinical Psychologist
description: My clinical interests include trauma and complex trauma, OCD, perinatal mental health, personality disorders, anxiety disorders and neurodivergence. Therapeutic approaches include Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR), Ego State Therapy (Parts Work) and Schema Therapy. EMDR Association of Australia (EMDRAA) Associate Member.
specialties: trauma, complex trauma, EMDR, parts work, schema therapy, OCD, perinatal, neurodivergence

name: Brenda Fenton
title: Senior Clinical Psychologist
description: Areas of interest include trauma, EMDR, relationship challenges, sleep difficulties, neurodivergence, perfectionism, and childhood/developmental trauma. Approaches include Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR) - Level 1 training completed, and Schema Therapy. (Currently on leave, not accepting new clients.)
specialties: trauma, EMDR, schema therapy, developmental trauma, neurodivergence

name: Danielle Anderson
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I enjoy working with teenagers and adults and have a strong interest in anxiety/phobias, depression, PTSD and trauma, burnout and life adjustment stress, OCD, self-esteem concerns, grief/loss and family and relationship difficulty. Approaches include Schema Therapy, Cognitive Processing Therapy and Imagery Rescripting for trauma.
specialties: PTSD, trauma, schema therapy, CPT, OCD, eating disorders, neurodivergence

name: Lauren Rizzo
title: Clinical Psychology Registrar
description: I work with clients experiencing challenges related to anxiety, mood, eating disorders and body image concerns, trauma and complex trauma, motivation and anger amongst others. Approaches include Imagery Rescripting for trauma, Trauma-focused CBT and Schema Therapy.
specialties: trauma, complex trauma, schema therapy, eating disorders, neuro-affirming assessment

name: Elisa Yildiz
title: Clinical Psychology Registrar
description: I work with clients across the lifespan (children, adolescents and adults) experiencing challenges relating to anxiety, mood, trauma, relationships and interpersonal difficulties, grief/loss, adjustment and life transitions, stress and self-esteem. Approaches include Schema Therapy.
specialties: trauma, schema therapy, anxiety, mood, relationships, grief

name: Natasha Blackburn
title: Provisional Psychologist
description: I have supported individuals experiencing a range of concerns, including trauma and complex trauma, anxiety, mood difficulties, relationship and adjustment challenges, grief, identity and self-esteem concerns, and perfectionism. I have a particular interest in supporting LGBTQIA+ and neurodivergent individuals, and I aim to create an inclusive and affirming therapeutic space.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, trauma, complex trauma, neurodivergence, identity
